asr.full_text: Welcome to another Cardano Update, like always make sure to check out our YouTube Memberships and our Patreon if you want access to our Daily Discord updates, here on the 4 hour chart there is still not much going on, we're trying to complete an AB setup for the much bigger fourth wave of the much bigger 12345 on the you know much bigger one two three four five setup on the daily chart but in my opinion if we do not manage to stay above 21.7 cents or let's say 22 cents the price is most likely going to get another low in the third with three downside between let's say 19.6 cents and even 15.1 cents and only after that we're gonna start a much bigger 4 twice later on i mean in the previous bear market we had a similar setup, we formed the, you know, other low on the 3rd wave to the downside, after we got a cross right there, and only after a couple of weeks or even months, we had a move to the upside which was a 4th wave, and then later on we got another low, so if we do end up finding a bottom, let's say by the end of May, and if we do end up getting like 19 cents or end of May.. and if we do end up getting to $0.19 or $0.15 and then we start a much bigger move to test the resistance for the fourth wave... I'm not gonna be surprised, But later on I'm still gonna expect a much bigger fifth wave, which would go pretty well with the fact that Bitcoin still is expected to bottom at the end of October and not the end of May... Now of course there is a reason to believe that maybe it's gonna bottom a bit sooner and the reason for that is actually something not Bitcoin related, but instead it's the S&P 500 chart I talked about this a couple of days ago, I believe when we were at $6600, I can even show you the discord message right here, but I warned that the S&P 500 chart might get rejected by the 200 day moving average which is probably going to start a much bigger drop exactly like what we had back in this area and back in that area we dropped about 20 percent and then later on we broke above all-time highs again and keep in mind during that time we also had a crossing ball market support band just like we did right here and yeah even though we got across and even though we got another move to the upside in the short term, in the long term, we broke below the Bomb Market support band first, just like right now, and then we broke below the 200-day moving average, now, you should already know this, because I talked about it, I actually want to show you something a bit different on the weekly chart, so speaking of that drop right there, of last year, that drop was very important because during that time I warned you that we got to the oversawed inventory in week 1 assay, and why was that important? Because if you just zoom out on the weekly chart right here, you will see that the S&P 500 chart does not get to the oversawed inventory way too many times, and it only got to the oversawed let's say 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 times in the last about 20 years or something like that, which is very bullish, and each time we got to the oversold territory that confirmed that some kind of bottom was in, of course here in the previous bear market of 2022 it ended up being a fake out, but even if that happened I mean as you can see back in May of 2022 we first almost got oversold, then we got a move to the upside which I believe was almost to the bond market support band then later on we got another move to the downside which was let's say in June of 2022 and that was very good because again you know that almost put us oversold and then we got another move to the upside we got rejected by the 200-day moving average and then later on we got another low but this was bullish just like on the bitcoin chart, we formed bullish divergence on the RSI which later on gave us new old-time highs and i think something like this is most likely going to happen again, if we look at the RSI right now it's at 35 and it has dropped quite a lot ever since we were above the bull market support band over here. I believe the R side dropped let's say 17 points or so which is extremely interesting the smp 500 chart like i said does not usually get oversold so what i think is going to happen right now is we're going to get the OVS territory during that time bitcoin is probably going to get to around 40 000 to complete the third wave or not the third Wave but the third drop of the cycle then later on Bitcoin is most likely going to get a move to the bar market support band to test it like it did every single bear market so far, and during that time Cardano is probably going to get a much bigger fourth with the upside, and then later in the year when we do end up getting a move to the bar market support band, and you know on the S&P 500 chart we end up getting rejected, and then we end up getting to the oversold territory right here for a second time like we did back in the previous bear market over there i think that's gonna be enough to maybe find a much bigger you know bottom right there and then start a much bigger move to the upside of course just like we did back in that area over there maybe we're gonna get to the oversold territory two times we're gonna get another move to the market support band we're gonna get rejected again and that's what's gonna give us another low and then only after that we start going up but even if that happens that would be the best case scenario during that time we could form bullish divergens on the rsi so the you know price could form a lower low but the rsi could form a higher low which is exactly what happened back in the previous bear market, and then later on maybe we are gonna get to all-time highs again, obviously not this year but probably let's say in 2028 or 2029, and the 4 year cycle on the bitcoin chart is still valid, I mean in the previous cycle we you know, pretty much topped exactly in October, and in the couple of cycles before this one we either November or December, which is not really a big difference so I think Bitcoin is gonna get another drop right now we're gonna get to $40,000 then we might test the spot ban at some point to maybe get that for the to the upset on the Cardano chart and then only after we do that we're probably gonna get another low to also complete the fifth wave on the Cardano chart and to also get to around $37,000 or maybe even $28,000 on the Bitcoin chart to get to the C wave target, and that's gonna probably be enough to complete a much bigger move later on in the next cycle. This would also go pretty well with the fact that on the monthly chart, I kind of want to see Bitcoin get to this 0.618 support level of the entire move to the upside, from the bear market lows of 2022 to the all-time highs of 2025, and why the 618, because if you take a Fibonacci of every single low and every single high, you will see that in the first cycle right there, we got a reaction to the 0.236, in the second cycle we got a reaction to the 0.382, in the third cycle we got a reaction to the 50%, and this means that if this setup is going to continue in this cycle, we're probably going to get a reaction to the 618, which happens to be at 34,000 dollars, and if we do end up getting to these lows, we're also going to get to the oversold territory for the first time ever on the monthly chart, which in my opinion is going to be way more than enough to finally break out of this downtrend over here, and then you know know getting moved to the upside later on which might just be a move, like for example, 2017 or even 2021. So I think, the next cycle has the potential to be even better please understand that in the next cycle we're gonna be in QE and not in QT the entire time and the last cycle that we were in QE was back here, when Cardano went from 1.7 cents to about 3.010 cents and again I want to remind you that Cardano, even in the previous cycle, when it dropped from 1.3 cents, which just happens to be exactly where we topped in this cycle, after we did that, and after we dropped to like I said 2 cents, we still managed to recover afterwards, only because Bitcoin broke above all time highs again, and during that time that's's when Bitcoin dominance broke down, I think Bitcoin dominance is most likely still going to break down, but it's probably not gonna be anytime soon, at best we are probably getting a move to about 53%, and during this time, Bitcoin is gonna be outperformed by Ethereum on the way down, but, you know, nothing is gonna go up in the short term, then later on, when Bitcoin starts getting all-time highs again, Bitcoin dominance is gonna start going higher and higher, like it up in the short term. Then later on, when Bitcoin starts getting all-time highs again, Bitcoin dominance is going to start going higher and higher, like it did in the entire bear market. And then after a while, after Bitcoin breaks all-time highs, like it did, for example, back there or back there, that's when Bitcoin dominance is going to break down, like in the previous cycle. And that's when we're going to hopefully start a much bigger move later on, which would only make sense because again, in the next cycle we're going to be in QE and not in QT and also because if you look at the RSI right here we had a similar setup to what we did back in the previous cycle however unlike the previous cycle I think that in this cycle it's going to take a bit longer for Bitcoin dominance to complete this setup but I think we are somewhere in this area over here we're gonna get a drop then we're gonna get another all-time high or cycle high and then only after that bitcoin dominance is gonna finally start breaking down and during that time let's say the rsi right now when we do end up getting to like 53 if we do that it's gonna get to around 43 or so then after we get a new cycle high during that move to the upside the rsi is probably not going to break above the previous RSI high, so I think we're going to get rejected by the moving average right there, we're going to form bearish divergence, which is pretty much exactly what we did back in this area, even though we got a new high on the percentile chart, on the RSI we actually formed a lower high, which was bearish divergence, and that's what gave us this move to the downside, this is what I'm watching, also before I end this video, let's also talk about the knight chart right here, knight is getting some kind of pump right now, which is very weird, I mean this setup is looking very, you know, let's just say bearish in my opinion, because even though we're getting a move to the upside, we are still below resistance, so in case night manages to get maybe above 5.7 cents, night could theoretically start a third wave of this one too, the 1-2 setup is still valid, but also understand that even if we get above let's say 5.7 cents, the only way to confirm that the low is in right there would be to get above 6.5 cents, which in my opinion is extremely difficult right now, if Bitcoin decides to go down right now, which is very likely because on the RSI, on the daily, we are still below the moving average right there. So if that happens, then I think Nite is probably going to go down as well, but who knows, like I said, if you want to prove me wrong, then the price has to get above 6.5 cents, and then I'm going to say that maybe you were right but for now yeah that's pretty much it I hope you enjoyed if you did make sure to check out our YouTube memberships and our Patreon if you want access to all of our shirts and if you want access to our daily discord updates like subscribe and I'll see you in the next one
